# StratLab Trading Library

> Free-to-read reference books on Indian (NSE) markets: options, option-chain analysis and adjustments, event trading, momentum, swing trading, price action, relative strength and breadth, stock selection, techno-funda investing, quant trading, risk management, chart types, TradingView and Screener.in, systematic trading frameworks, and an industry-wise fundamentals KPI handbook. Educational only — not investment advice; StratLab is not SEBI-registered. Content is AI-drafted and human-reviewed, not exhaustively fact-checked — verify specific numbers, formulas, and citations before relying on them. Four original books are CC BY 4.0; all others are © StratLab, free to read but not to redistribute — see /LICENSE.md. See /README.md for the full disclaimer and a log of corrections made during review.

<!-- Links below assume this repo is published as github.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library. If it ends up under a different org/username, update every raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library path in this file to match. -->

## Options Trading

- [The Complete Options Trader](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Options-Trading/The-Complete-Options-Trader.md): 30 chapters + 3 appendices. Foundations (contract mechanics, moneyness, payoff diagrams) through pricing and the Greeks (delta, gamma, theta, vega, Black-Scholes, IV) to the strategy playbook (spreads, straddles, iron condors, collars) and advanced concepts (volatility trading, gamma scalping, OI/PCR/max pain, Indian market mechanics).

## Momentum Trading

- [Momentum Trading: Ride the Trend](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Momentum-Trading/Momentum-Trading-Ride-the-Trend-Five-Proven-Breakout-and-Trend-Following-Strategies-for-NIFTY-and-Indian-Stocks.md): 10 chapters + appendix. Five price-action strategies for NIFTY and Indian stocks over a weeks-to-months horizon — Donchian breakout, MA trend following, 52-week high breakout, relative strength rotation, pullback to a rising MA — plus risk management and trading psychology.

## Momentum Investing

- [Momentum Investing: Build Long-Term Wealth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Momentum-Investing/Momentum-Investing-Build-Long-Term-Wealth-with-the-Time-Tested-Momentum-Factor.md): 10 chapters + appendix. The academic momentum factor applied to a long-horizon (months-to-years) Indian portfolio — 12-1 cross-sectional momentum, absolute (200-day) momentum, dual momentum, 52-week high investing, sector rotation — plus portfolio construction, Indian tax/cost mechanics, and the psychology of holding through drawdowns.

## Swing Trading

- [Swing Trading: Capture Multi-Day Moves](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Swing-Trading/Swing-Trading-Capture-Multi-Day-Moves-with-Five-Proven-Continuation-and-Reversion-Strategies.md): 10 chapters + appendix. Five days-to-weeks strategies split across both market regimes — pullback continuation, breakout and retest, new-high momentum (continuation); RSI-2 mean reversion, range fade (reversion) — with explicit guidance on reading which regime you're in, trade plans, and risk arithmetic.

## Techno-Funda

- [Techno-Funda](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Techno-Funda/Techno-Funda-Strategy-Ideas-That-Combine-Fundamental-Quality-with-Technical-Timing.md): 10 chapters + appendix. Five ideas fusing a fundamental screen (quality, growth, value, dividend, earnings momentum) with a technical trigger (breakout, pullback, reversal), plus a repeatable screening workflow.

## Risk Management

- [Risk Management and Position Sizing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Risk-Management/Risk-Management-and-Position-Sizing-The-Discipline-That-Keeps-You-in-the-Game.md): 9 chapters + appendix. The math of ruin and drawdown, the 1-2% risk-per-trade foundation, five position-sizing methods (fixed-fraction, fixed-ratio, ATR, Kelly, fractional-Kelly), stop types, portfolio-level risk, margin/leverage/tail risk, and a written risk-framework template. Applies across every other book in this library.

## Quant Trading

- [Quant Trading: Strategies and Ideas](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Quant-Trading/Quant-Trading-Strategies-and-Ideas.md): 10 chapters + appendix. The idea-to-live pipeline, evaluation metrics (Sharpe, Sortino, profit factor, expectancy), five systematic strategies (cross-sectional momentum, mean reversion/pairs, time-series trend, factor tilts, vol targeting/seasonality) with pseudocode, seven backtesting pitfalls, and the gap between backtest and live.

## Systematic Trading Framework

- [How to Build a Framework for Systematic Trading](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Systematic-Trading-Framework/How-to-Build-a-Framework-for-Systematic-Trading.md): 10 chapters + appendix. The eight-stage lifecycle (idea → hypothesis → data → signal → backtest → paper → live → review/retire), data integrity, signal design, portfolio construction, honest backtesting, execution/monitoring, and governance — the infrastructure the other books' strategies plug into.

## Charts and Chart Types

- [Charts and Chart Types](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Charts-and-Chart-Types/Charts-and-Chart-Types-The-Complete-Guide-to-Reading-Price.md): 11 chapters + appendix. Line, area, bar, candlestick, and Heikin-Ashi through the noise-reducing reversal-based charts (Renko, Point & Figure, line break, Kagi) to the logarithmic scale — what each chart type keeps, discards, and is good for.

## TradingView Masterclass

- [TradingView Masterclass](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/TradingView-Masterclass/TradingView-Masterclass-Tips-Tricks-and-How-to-Use-It-Most-Effectively.md): 10 chapters + appendix. Workspace and chart setup, templates, drawing tools, indicators/strategies, watchlists and multi-chart layouts, alerts, bar replay, compare/multi-timeframe, and paper trading — how to use the platform as a workflow, not just a viewer.

## KPI Handbook

- [The Indian Stock Market KPI Handbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/KPI-Handbook/The-Indian-Stock-Market-KPI-Handbook.md): 32 chapters + appendix. Industry-wise operational KPIs for 29 Indian sectors (banks, NBFCs, insurance, IT, pharma, FMCG, autos, metals, cement, oil & gas, power, telecom, realty and more) — what each KPI means, how it is commonly read, indicative benchmarks, a healthy-profile-vs-red-flags checklist per industry, and where to source each number — plus a data-source directory, a master KPI table and a glossary. Describes how businesses operate; says nothing about valuation or what to buy.

## Option Chain Analysis

- [Option Chain Analysis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Option-Chain-Analysis/Option-Chain-Analysis-Reading-Positioning-and-Building-Quant-Models-from-the-Chain.md): 14 + appendix chapters. Reading the option chain as data: open interest, put-call ratio, IV skew and term structure, max pain, dealer delta and gamma exposure, the implied distribution, the variance risk premium, expected move and implied support/resistance, combined into a composite model — with the pitfalls of each.

## Options Trading Adjustments

- [Options Trading Adjustments](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Options-Trading-Adjustments/Options-Trading-Adjustments.md): 12 + appendix chapters. Five common option structures on the NSE (covered call, bull call spread, iron condor, short strangle, long straddle) — how each behaves as the market moves, the adjustments traders use, and a decision framework, with payoff diagrams.

## Event and Earnings Trading

- [Event & Earnings Trading on the NSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Event-and-Earnings-Trading/Event-Earnings-Trading-on-the-NSE.md): 9 + appendix chapters. The Indian results calendar and other scheduled events, implied-volatility crush, gap behaviour, and a list of situations where events are better left alone.

## Price Action

- [Price Action Playbook for Nifty & Stocks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Price-Action-Playbook/Price-Action-Playbook-for-Nifty-Stocks.md): 12 + appendix chapters. Market structure, auctions and the value area, balance and imbalance, levels, failed breakouts, continuation and reversal setups, and the Indian session clock (including NSE's closing auction).

## Relative Strength and Breadth

- [Relative Strength & Breadth for the NSE Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Relative-Strength-and-Breadth/Relative-Strength-Breadth-for-the-NSE-Market.md): 12 + appendix chapters. Computing relative strength against the index and peers, sector rotation, the core breadth indicators (A/D line, % above moving averages, new highs/lows, McClellan) and divergences, and a top-down breadth → sector → stock process.

## Stock Selection

- [The Indian Stock Selector's Playbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Stock-Selection-Methods/The-Indian-Stock-Selectors-Playbook.md): 10 + 4 appendices chapters. Three systematic stock-selection methods for the NSE — value, momentum and multi-factor — with portfolio construction, position sizing, backtesting and validation, Indian-market pitfalls, data sources and example screens.

## Screener.in Masterclass

- [Screener.in Masterclass](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Screener-in-Masterclass/Screenerin-Masterclass-The-Complete-Guide-to-Indias-Fundamental-Research-Tool.md): 10 + appendix chapters. Using Screener.in for fundamental research: reading a company page, writing screen queries, the ratios that matter, shareholding and peers, long-term growth and valuation, custom ratios and exports.

## TradingView Screeners

- [TradingView Screeners with Pine Script v6](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/TradingView-Screeners/TradingView-Screeners-with-Pine-Script-v6-Recognised-Strategy-Scanners-Fully-Coded.md): 12 + appendix chapters. Eight scanners written in Pine Script v6 for TradingView's Pine Screener — valuation, earnings power, momentum, stage analysis, outperformance, price contraction, Dow Theory and multi-timeframe trend — plus a consolidated 0–8 score script (`consolidated-8-factor-screener.pine`).

## Swing Screener in Python

- [Build Your Own Swing Trading Screener](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivrwealth-ui/trading-library/main/Swing-Screener-Guide/Build-Your-Own-Swing-Trading-Screener.md): 10 + appendix chapters. A beginner's Python project: download NIFTY 50 prices, compute moving averages and RSI, detect the trend regime, flag pullback and RSI-2 setups, and write a daily HTML report — with the full program (`screener.py`).
